The PKI infrastructure (comprising software and High Security Module (HSM)) decrypts information on a physical card and verifies the authenticity of the card containing the encrypted information. There were approximately 340,000 eRPs processed in 2024, and approximately 320,000 in 2025. The Contracting Authority proposes to engage in a competitive process for the establishment of a contract for the provision of a Managed Service to maintain a long-standing national Public Key Infrastructure including resale of PKI software and maintenance and supporting hardware and maintenance. Also included in this service will be expertise and per diem rates to implement new functionality in the PKI infrastructure and connected systems in the Department of Justice, Home Affairs and Migration. It is important to note that this is a critical service involving physical devices. To meet the required incident management service levels, the Successful Tenderer must maintain a dedicated physical presence in Dublin, enabling a maximum incident response time of one hour and a maximum incident resolution time of four hours.
